content_sections.heading: PDKV Notification PDF 2026
content_sections.text: Advt No. CAN/Advt/Comp/3095/2026 gives the full conditions for the post, including anything not covered in the tables on this page. Read it before applying. The download link is in the Important Links table below. Download PDKV notification PDF

content_sections.heading: Eligibility Criteria
content_sections.text: Qualification: M.E./M.Tech. (Computer Science)/M.C.A./M.Sc. (Computer Science) with NET/SET; or Ph.D. in Computer Science Age limit: As per norms

content_sections.heading: Pay and Terms of Engagement
content_sections.text: Contract period 11 months Order issued initially for 6 months; may be extended for next 5 months as per need, depending on performance Term co-terminus with filling of permanent/regular posts, completion of tenure or performance, whichever is earlier Consent letter of engagement stands automatically terminated after completion of the period

content_sections.heading: How Will PDKV Select Candidates?
content_sections.text: Walk-in interview with a 10-minute PowerPoint presentation Candidates must bring a 10-minute PowerPoint presentation on a topic of interest in the related field at the time of interview

content_sections.heading: Documents to Enclose
content_sections.text: Filled Application Form Original documents of date of birth, educational qualifications, experience certificate, NET/SET (if passed) Caste Certificate, Caste Validity and Non-Creamy Layer (if applicable) All publications and other relevant documents for the claim One set of self-attested photocopies of all documents One recent passport size colour photograph

content_sections.heading: How to Apply for PDKV Recruitment 2026
content_sections.text: Download the Application Form from www.pdkv.ac.in under the Recruitments tab. Fill in the form. Carry the filled form with xerox copies and originals of all documents to the walk-in interview on 19/11/2026. Report between 10.00 AM and 11.30 AM at the Office of Associate Dean, College of Agriculture, Opposite Maharajbagh Zoo, Nagpur.

content_sections.heading: Other Points to Note
content_sections.text: Number of posts, mode, place, date or time of interview may change, or interviews may be cancelled Changes in interview date will be posted on www.pdkv.ac.in/Recruitments

faq.question: Q1. When is the walk-in interview for PDKV Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: The walk-in interview is on 19 November 2026, and candidates report at 10:00 AM.

faq.question: Q2. How many vacancies are there in PDKV Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: There is 1 vacancy for Assistant Professor in Computer Science (Contractual).

faq.question: Q3. How do I apply for PDKV Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: Attend the walk-in interview on 19 November 2026 at 10:00 AM. The steps and the documents to bring are under How to Apply above.

faq.question: Q4. Where is the walk-in interview for this recruitment?
faq.answer: Office of Associate Dean, College of Agriculture, Opposite Maharajbagh Zoo, Nagpur.

faq.question: Q5. What is the salary for this recruitment?
faq.answer: Fixed Rs 45000 per month.

faq.question: Q6. What qualification is needed for this recruitment?
faq.answer: M.E./M.Tech. (Computer Science)/M.C.A./M.Sc. (Computer Science) with NET/SET or Ph.D. in Computer Science.

faq.question: Q7. How will candidates be selected for this recruitment?
faq.answer: Walk-in interview with a 10-minute PowerPoint presentation. Candidates must bring a 10-minute PowerPoint presentation on a topic of interest in the related field at the time of interview.

faq.question: Q8. What are the terms of engagement for this recruitment?
faq.answer: Contract period 11 months. Order issued initially for 6 months; may be extended for next 5 months as per need, depending on performance. Term co-terminus with filling of permanent/regular posts, completion of tenure or performance, whichever is earlier.

faq.question: Q9. Where is the posting for this recruitment?
faq.answer: Agricultural Engineering Section, College of Agriculture, Nagpur.

faq.question: Q10. Which documents are needed for this recruitment?
faq.answer: Filled Application Form; Original documents of date of birth, educational qualifications, experience certificate, NET/SET (if passed); Caste Certificate, Caste Validity and Non-Creamy Layer (if applicable); All publications and other relevant documents for the claim; One set of self-attested photocopies of all documents; One recent passport size colour photograph.
